name: The Artificer
blurb: Fills in the Artificer from Eberron: Forge of the Artificer: its class features, all six subclasses and a spell list.
contents: 19 class features, with plans known and magic items at each level
6 subclasses with 40 features: Alchemist, Armorer, Artillerist, Battle Smith, Cartographer, Reanimator
Always-prepared subclass spells on the sheet
The 2024 artificer spell list: 73 spells from the free rules, plus Homunculus Servant from the book
about: Feature texts are summaries from your classes workbook; check the book for exact wording. The spell list comes from your spell data of 21 November 2026. Switch on More 2024 spells as well and the artificer gets the rest of its list, such as Arcane Vigor, Thorn Whip and Thunderclap.

classFeatures: Half caster using Int; prepared Artificer spells, ritual casting. Focus: Thieves' Tools or any Artisan's Tools you're proficient with.
Know Mending. Magic action with Tinker's Tools: create a mundane item from a set list within 5 ft (vanishes on Long Rest). Uses = Int mod (min 1) per Long Rest.
Learn magic item plans (4 at L2, up to 8). After a Long Rest, create 1–2 items from your plans (max items 2→6 by level). Created wands/weapons can be your focus; items vanish 1d4 days after you die.
Choose your Artificer specialist. Subclass features at levels 3, 5, 9, 15.
Take the ASI feat (+2 to one score or +1 to two) or another feat you qualify for.
Gain your Artificer specialist feature for this level (see Subclass Features).
Bonus Action: recharge a created charged item with a spell slot; or drain a created item for a level 1–2 slot (1/LR); Magic action: transmute a created item into another plan (1/LR).
Reaction: when you or a creature within 30 ft fails an ability check or save, add your Int mod (min +1). Uses = Int mod per Long Rest.
Take the ASI feat (+2 to one score or +1 to two) or another feat you qualify for.
Gain your Artificer specialist feature for this level (see Subclass Features).
Attune to up to 4 magic items.
After a Long Rest, store a level 1–3 Artificer spell (action cast time) in a weapon or focus; holder casts it with a Magic action. Uses = 2× Int mod (min 2).
Take the ASI feat (+2 to one score or +1 to two) or another feat you qualify for.
Attune to up to 5 items; regain one Flash of Genius use on a Short Rest.
Gain your Artificer specialist feature for this level (see Subclass Features).
Take the ASI feat (+2 to one score or +1 to two) or another feat you qualify for.
Attune to up to 6 magic items.
Gain an Epic Boon feat (or another feat you qualify for).
Cheat Death: at 0 HP, disintegrate any number of your Uncommon/Rare replicated items; HP becomes 20 × items destroyed. Short Rest restores all Flash of Genius uses if attuned to an item.
Proficiency with Alchemist's Supplies and Herbalism Kit (or other Artisan's Tools); potions take half the time to craft.
Always prepared — L3: Healing Word, Ray of Sickness; L5: Flaming Sphere, Melf's Acid Arrow; L9: Gaseous Form, Mass Healing Word; L13: Death Ward, Vitriolic Sphere; L17: Cloudkill, Raise Dead

After a Long Rest make 2 random elixirs (3 at L5, 4 at L9, 5 at L15): Healing 2d8+Int, Swiftness +10 ft, Resilience +1 AC, Boldness +1d4 attacks/saves, Flight 10 ft (scale at L9/L15). Bonus Action to drink/administer. Magic action + slot: make one of your choice.
Spells cast through Alchemist's Supplies add Int mod (min +1) to one healing roll or Acid/Fire/Poison damage roll.
Cast Lesser Restoration without a slot or preparation, Int mod times per Long Rest.
Once per turn +2d8 Force when an Artificer spell deals Acid/Fire/Poison; Resistance to Acid and Poison, immune to Poisoned; cast Tasha's Bubbling Cauldron free 1/Long Rest.
Heavy armor training and Smith's Tools; armor crafting takes half the time.
Always prepared — L3: Magic Missile, Thunderwave; L5: Mirror Image, Shatter; L9: Hypnotic Pattern, Lightning Bolt; L13: Fire Shield, Greater Invisibility; L17: Passwall, Wall of Force
Magic action with Smith's Tools: worn armor becomes Arcane Armor — no Str requirement, don/doff as a Utilize action, can't be removed against your will, acts as your spellcasting focus.

Choose (change on a rest): Dreadnaught (Force Demolisher 1d10 reach, push/pull 10 ft; Giant Stature BA: Large + 5 ft reach, Int mod/LR), Guardian (Thunder Pulse 1d8, Disadvantage vs others; Defensive Field temp HP = Artificer level while Bloodied), Infiltrator (Lightning Launcher 1d6 90/300 + 1d6 once/turn; +5 ft Speed; Advantage on Stealth). Model weapons use Int.
Attack twice when you take the Attack action.
Learn an extra Armor plan and make an extra Armor item with Replicate Magic Item; +1 to attack and damage with your model's weapon.

Dreadnaught: 2d6 weapon, +10 ft reach, Large or Huge, Advantage on Str. Guardian: 1d10 weapon, Reaction pull a creature 25 ft and attack. Infiltrator: 2d6 weapon, hit targets glow and have Disadvantage vs you, BA flight at 2× Speed (Int mod/LR).
Martial Ranged weapons and Woodcarver's Tools; crafting a Wand takes half the time.
Always prepared — L3: Shield, Thunderwave; L5: Scorching Ray, Shatter; L9: Fireball, Wind Wall; L13: Ice Storm, Wall of Fire; L17: Cone of Cold, Wall of Force

Magic action: create a Small/Tiny cannon (AC 18, HP 5× Artificer level) for 1 hour; 1/Long Rest or spend a slot. Bonus Action within 60 ft: Flamethrower (15-ft Cone, Dex save 2d8 Fire), Force Ballista (120 ft spell attack, 2d8 Force + push 5 ft) or Protector (1d8 + Int temp HP within 10 ft); move it 15 ft.
Carve sigils into a wand, staff, rod or Martial Ranged weapon; Artificer spells cast through it add 1d8 to one damage roll.
Cannon damage and temp HP +1d8. Reaction when the cannon takes damage: detonate it — 20-ft radius Dex save, 3d10 Force.
Have two cannons at once (create both with one action, activate both with one Bonus Action); you and allies within 10 ft of a cannon have Half Cover.
Smith's Tools proficiency; crafting weapons takes half the time.
Always prepared — L3: Heroism, Shield; L5: Shining Smite, Warding Bond; L9: Aura of Vitality, Conjure Barrage; L13: Aura of Purity, Fire Shield; L17: Banishing Smite, Mass Cure Wounds
Martial weapon proficiency; use Int for attack and damage with magic weapons; use a proficient weapon as your spellcasting focus.

Construct companion (AC 12 + Int, HP 5 + 5× Artificer level, Speed 40). Dodges unless commanded (Bonus Action): Force-Empowered Rend 1d8 + 2 + Int Force; Repair 2d8 + Int (3/day); Reaction imposes Disadvantage on attacks vs others. Revive with a slot within 1 hour.
Attack twice; can replace one attack to command the Steel Defender's Rend.
When you or your defender hit with a magic weapon/Rend: +2d6 Force, or heal a creature within 30 ft 2d6. Int mod uses per Long Rest, once per turn.
Arcane Jolt becomes 4d6; Deflect Attack also deals 1d4 + Int Force to the attacker.
Calligrapher's Supplies and Cartographer's Tools; scribing Spell Scrolls takes half the time.
Always prepared — L3: Faerie Fire, Guiding Bolt, Healing Word; L5: Locate Object, Mind Spike; L9: Call Lightning, Clairvoyance; L13: Banishment, Locate Creature; L17: Scrying, Teleportation Circle
After a Long Rest give maps to 2 to 1 + Int mod creatures (incl. you). Holders add 1d4 to Initiative, know each other's location, and you can target holders in range without sight or cover.
Cast Faerie Fire without a slot Int mod times per Long Rest. Portal Jump: spend half your Speed to teleport to a space within 10 ft, or within 5 ft of a map holder within 30 ft.
Once per turn add Int mod to damage of a Cartographer spell or an attack vs a Faerie Fire target; damage can't break your Concentration on Faerie Fire.
When you use Flash of Genius, you or a willing creature within 30 ft can also teleport up to 30 ft.
Safe Haven: a holder dropping to 0 HP destroys its map instead, gains HP = 2× Artificer level and teleports beside you or another holder. Cast Find the Path free 1/Long Rest.
Always prepared — L3: False Life, Spare the Dying, Witch Bolt; L5: Blindness/Deafness, Enhance Ability; L9: Animate Dead, Lightning Bolt; L13: Blight, Death Ward; L17: Antilife Shell, Raise Dead

Alchemist's Supplies proficiency. Jolt to Life: when you cast Spare the Dying, the target regains HP = Artificer level and chosen creatures within 10 ft make a Dex save, 2d4 Lightning (3d4 at L11, 4d4 at L17). Int mod uses per Long Rest.

Magic action: create an Undead companion (AC 10 + Int, HP 5 + 5× Artificer level, Speed 30, Blindsight 60) until Long Rest; 1/Long Rest or a slot. Dreadful Swipe 1d4 + Int Necrotic (no OAs); heals from Lightning; Death Burst 2d4 Necrotic on death. Dodges unless commanded (Bonus Action).
Give each new companion one mod: Arcane Conduit (cast spells from its space; +Int to one Evocation/Necromancy damage roll) or Ferocity (Swipe die becomes 1d6).
Death Burst becomes 4d4; companion's Necrotic damage ignores Resistance.
Two mods per companion; new options Bloated (Large, Swipe pushes 10 ft, +Int to Death Burst), Gaunt (Speed 45 + climb, frightening presence) and Moist (swim, squeeze, Acid damage to attackers).
Cast Raise Dead free 1/Long Rest; Reaction when you or the companion take damage: gain HP equal to its HP and it dies (Death Burst); three mods per companion.
